<!-- pr-reviewer: e7050be171c317412fb52973496df1983b1efa55 -->
**Verdict: clean. This is the independent review. No blockers.**

**Head and trial merge.** Head e7050be17. The trial merge with origin/main (57f2ffbbf) is clean. It has no conflicts. #2138 was built on top of #2147, because main does not build camcraft-ui alone (E0004, issue #2143).

**Suites (local, Windows, debug).** `cargo test -p camcraft-sim`: 696 passed, 0 failed. The 13 new sim unit tests pass: prior_traverse 7, traverse_solids 6. `cargo test -p camcraft-app --test clearance_in_stock`: 8 passed, 0 failed. `--test operations`: 120 passed, 0 failed, 6 ignored. `--lib`: 349 passed, 0 failed (clearance_stock unit tests 3). `cargo clippy -p camcraft-sim -p camcraft-app --all-targets -- -D warnings`: clean.

**Safety-law findings.**
(a) The law. `rapids.rs` drops the clearance gate. Every lateral rapid under the stock top is marched against the column. Only the stock top stands the law down. A NaN height still marches. The change adds convictions; it removes none.
(b) The refusal names the condition. The warning sentence is "travels through stock (below the clearance plane, or at it below the stock top)". The path note names both planes and the fix. The post refuses and writes nothing. A pin proves it. Nothing passes silent.
(c) The numbers. The new code uses clamped index math (floor and ceil with max and min, a count check, `saturating_add`). No `unwrap`, `expect` or `panic!` is outside a `#[cfg(test)]` block.
(d) One source. The post gate, generate's re-reads and the MCP word all go through `operation::clearance_stock`. There is no second derivation of the clearance verdict.
(e) Pins. `crates/app/tests/clearance_in_stock.rs` has 8 tests. sim has 7 (prior_traverse) and 6 (traverse_solids). app lib has 3 (clearance_stock). The issue's repro is pinned, with the post held.

**Notes (not blocking).**
1. A path cached before this fix keeps its cached verdict until a regenerate. An old saved project can still post a plane inside the stock. A stamp bump or a release-notes line is the maintainer's call.
2. `prior_clear` reads a capsule wholly off the prior grid as air. The grid covers the judged stock, and the part guard reads the part apart. The older `acquit_by_prior` reads an off-grid disc as unknown. The two readings differ; no failing case is known.
3. The #1559 branch edits the same `generate.rs` lines. The body names the overlap. Whichever merges second takes a small refresh.
4. The UI does not show the creation word yet. Issue #2131 tracks that.

**Law checks.** The decision file matches the `docs/decisions/README.md` format. The body has its Changelog line and its closing reference. No process file, Cargo.toml, build.rs, .github file or snapshot PNG is touched. Each new module has its provenance line. The naming is neutral. The refusal texts are plain English. Each new file is under 400 lines.

<!-- review-cost: e7050be171c317412fb52973496df1983b1efa55 -->
effort:high · independent lane review landed clean · escalated: no

Follow-ups from this review, filed as issues (both from the non-blocking notes above): #2152 (P1: a cache made under the old rapids law posts without the new verdict until regenerate - the stamp and version migration are the fix), and #2153 (P7: the off-grid air reading in the prior re-read - prove or tighten).
